titles.native: 東京マグニチュード8.0 総集編

description:
Special recap of Tokyo Magnitude 8.0, aired in commemoration of the Excellence Prize that was awarded to the series on the 13th Japan Media Arts Festival.

Note: Two versions of this recap exists. The first being a 65-minute TV airing broadcast on Fuji TV on December 12, 2009. And the second a 95-minute movie released in 3 theaters on January 17, 2010, in commemoration of the 15th anniversary of the Great Hanshin earthquake.
